verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical: both just scale the original block up and drop it into the taller canvas instead of rearranging it, which leaves a big empty band (about 100 px) at the top and another at the bottom. The info line runs nearly to the right edge in both, and the 'GALLERY|' divider sits right against the Y. Neither uses the story format: the headline stays small, the artwork is not enlarged to fill the frame, and there is no top-to-bottom flow. The only difference is a few pixels in where the artwork sits vertically, so I can't pick one over the other.
